changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'ck_artifact_signal_state' AND conrelid = 'artifact_signal'::regclass AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%DEFERRED%'

changeSet.comment: Admit the state a signal waits in for a coalescing sweep. The state existed in the application before it existed here, so every deferred signal was refused by the database and its message was retried until the consumer dropped it as poison, losing the occasion.
